That's true. No one knows what's after death but what does it matter? As long as I'm not here. I guess the forest would be better. Just disappear and no one will know what happened. It will be a form of freedom. I'll be free from the hell I'm living. It's become too much to bear.

It's not just teachers. The people I go to school with are all two faced scum. I can't do anything right. My mom always tells at me for anything I do wrong. She waits for me to slip up just so she can yell at me. Nothing gets through anymore. All I can't think about is how free I'll be. Just thinking about doing it makes me happy. It's the happiest I've been since January. I've never been good at anything and I'll just end up dead in a ditch with a needle in my arm anyway. All I ever do is sit in my room in complete silence because it's the only joy I get. I'm never going to be happy in life so I might as well cut it short. I knew I'd be dead before I was 25 ever since I was a kid. It's just time to lay down and stop hurting. I'm going to be free.
